taylor Swift - The Fate of Ophelia MP3 DOWNLOAD

The Fate of Ophelia” is the opening track of Taylor Swift’s twelfth studio album, “The Life of a Showgirl.” The title refers to how in William Shakespeare’s famous play “Hamlet,” Ophelia goes insane and commits suicide by drowning herself after her father’s death.
